title: Load Order Change Guidance - Rework 1
outcome_summary: All 5 targeted hardening items for the load order change guidance feature were delivered in a single session with zero rework cycles: BuildConfirmationMessage() was extracted into a testable internal method with 2 new passing unit tests (eliminating 2 skipped tests), 9 inline foreground hex literals in DiffWindow.xaml were consolidated into 7 named SolidColorBrush resources, a fully localized Moved guidance sidebar card was added across 8 locales with 5 new unit tests, UpdateDiffState()'s 24-call OnPropertyChanged list was replaced with a single OnPropertyChanged(string.Empty), and the dead DependentCause_Added locale key was removed from all 8 locale files. The final test suite stands at 499 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, with clean builds throughout.
project_summary: Harden the load order change guidance feature delivered in the prior plan by extracting confirmation-message building logic into a testable method with unit tests, consolidating inline foreground color literals into named brush resources, adding a Moved guidance sidebar card with full localization, simplifying the property notification mechanism in UpdateDiffState(), and removing a dead locale key from all 8 locales.
